notes: **Item REF2: citation fixes from the citation audit** (References session, 2026-10-01). Your decisions on the 13 findings of `references/citation_audit.md`, plus the closing of the TODO comments that the audit resolved. Evidence (quote and page for each verdict): `references/citation_audit.md`, section "Verdicts and evidence".

**Your answers applied here:** 1 Corke dropped · 2 new source found: AACC (2001), the dietary-fiber definition, free, already downloaded (`references/pdfs/AACC2001.pdf`), nothing for you to get · 3 Houston + Hrmova · 4 Burton → Houston · 5 kept + Word comment 428 · 6 Keeling et al. 1993 added (yes, the Pintel thesis cites it for the soluble starch synthase) · 7 kept + Word comment 104 · 8 Nevo: kept as written (change 3 discarded at review) · 9 Guo dropped, Irigoyen added to the AGPase sentence · 10 reworded to the papers' terms · 11 Hübner 2013 kept, no change · 12 Beljkaš dropped · 13 answered in Word comment 216 (below) · FAO dropped → Farag 2022 · can't-verify comments: 102 and 401 (Friedman), 257 (Holland).

**Your question 13 (soil variables):** neither Potapenko paper describes them. Mol Biol Evol (Methods p. 9 and its Table S1, which I downloaded from PMC) lists as lab measurements only EC, field capacity, silt, clay, total C, inorganic C and organic material; its sand and pH are ISRIC map values; total N and organic C are not there. Mol Ecol uses soil only as ISRIC map layers (pH, CEC) in its distribution model. Your values (pH, sand, organic C, total N from Evgenii's site table) are lab values that neither paper reports. Comment 216 now says this; how to describe them is still open.

**Reference list after REF2:** leave the list: Burton 2008, Guo 2008, Beljkaš 2010, FAO 2025. New: AACC 2001, Keeling et al. 1993, Xu et al. 2018. Corke 1989 stays (Discussion §2 ¶3). TODO comments removed: 101, 103, 212, 221, 225, 226, 230, 233, 304, 305, 307, 308, 408, 409, 411. Still open: 102, 216, 401 (updated), 104, 257, 428 (new).

**Decisions at review (2026-10-01):** all changes approved except change 3 (Nevo rewording; kept as written). Q1: (a) and (b) approved and added as the last two changes; (c) not applied. Q2: "such as those of the pericarp and testa" kept (Claude's choice; the user had no preference).
